Calculate measures of dissimilarity (wrapper) between sites

Source: R/hib_site_contrasts.R
hib_calc_site_contrasts.Rd

This function calculates dissimilarity measures between sites within a study, for use as covariates in models of comopositional dis/similarity

Usage

hib_calc_site_contrasts(
  obj,
  metrics,
  custom_metric_specs = NULL,
  baseline_lui = "Primary vegetation_Minimal use",
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

obj

A HibDatabase object.

metrics

A character vector of 'distance' metrics. Current options are; "lui_contrast", "geogr_dist_hav", "geogr_dist_geod" and "geogr_midpoint", "env_dist".

custom_metric_specs

A named list with each named item containing the specifications for the named custom metric. Custom metrics must be based on vegdist distance metrics. Essential named values within the specifications of a custom metric are: dist_metr - a character indicating the metric of choice; vars - a character vector indicating the site variables to use when calculating the distance metric. For example: list(Gower_dist_a = list(dist_metr = "gower", vars = c("env1", "env2", "env3")), Gower_dist_b = list(dist_metr = "gower", vars = c("env4", "env5", "env6"))) Metric names (as specified in the name of the sub-lists) will be converted to sentence-case in the output data.

baseline_lui

A character or NULL, indicating the baseline LUI against which dis/similarity is calculated per study - should match the value used when calculating compositional dis/similarity (hib_calc_div_between)

overwrite

A logical indicating whether or not any current site contrast data should be over-written.

Details

Expects a HibDatabase object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  obj <- hib_calc_site_contrasts(obj, 
                              c("lui_contrast", "geogr_dist_hav"),
                              "Primary vegetation_Minimal use")
} # }
